# RoleField

## Summary

RoleField is the host-role enum — a `StringField` enum listing the wedding roles a Host can hold (as defined by `HOST_ROLES` in `../host`). It distinguishes the couple and their key helpers from ordinary guests so the planner's host panel and the print sheet can label them correctly.

## Import

```js
import { RoleField } from '../host';
```

## Usage as a Field

```ts
@field role = contains(RoleField);
```

## Template Usage

```handlebars
{{@model.role}}
```
